channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Friday’s conversion news is utilities and sponsors locking large loads behind customer-funded generation and free-trade-zone campuses. NiSource announced a 20-year GenCo energy agreement with Microsoft for the northwest Indiana campus: about 1,100 MW of new generation from 2028, Microsoft funding generation and transmission for its load, and GenCo adding 600 MW of battery storage under an AGP tolling deal, with expected NIPSCO customer savings raised to about $1.75 billion. Uruguay and Solaria signed a strategic FTZ agreement for up to 500 MW of data-center campus capacity plus up to 350 MW solar (MIEM cites US$5.7 billion; binding still ahead), and EdgeConneX launched a 50:50 Australia JV with Stockland with 450 MW secured for Sydney and Melbourne. On the economics tape, CoreWeave’s 2031 notes were yielding about 15.8% and 5-year CDS last near 1,038 bps after the Gartner scare, while Larry Fink warned a US data-center moratorium would mean recession. Public silicon tape: 67 confirms, 2 ticks, 0 NEW — Crusoe H200 on-demand $4.29 to $5.40 and H100 $3.90 to $4.50; Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 and AWS CB B200 $14.208 / B300 $16.146 held.
